newsitem.title: BELGIUM: W. Europe Aug car registrations up 5.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: W. Europe Aug car registrations up 5.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: New passenger car registrations rose 5.2 percent year-on-year in western Europe in August, the European Automobile Manufacturers Association (ACEA) said on Thursday.
It said registrations rose to 1,157,200 from 1,100,100 the same month last year. -- Brussels newsroom +32 2 287 68 11
